role.altitude: The biochemist keeps designing methods and experiments, working at the bench and instruments, building ideas for grants and judging structures; literature sweeps, notebook entries, grant annexes and routine data processing shrink.
skills_to_grow: Running versioned pipelines and checking screening and extraction against a sample
role.ambitious_version: A biochemist who screens the whole literature for a new method in days and spends the time gained at the bench.

tasks.short: Review the literature for existing methods, design and develop new methods to study the mechanisms of biological processes, test and optimise them at the bench and record protocols and results.

steps.what: Biochemist reviews the literature for existing methods

loop.input: Papers found by saved searches on the topic.
loop.output: Screened papers with method details extracted per paper, each with the quoted passage.
loop.check: Every extracted item quotes the paper; a second scientist checks a sample; every cited paper must resolve to a DOI.
loop.why_not_simpler: Method details are written differently in every paper.

steps.what: Biochemist designs the new method
Biochemist tests and optimises the method at the bench
Biochemist records protocols and results in the lab notebook

tasks.design: Saved literature searches feed a screening and extraction step that pulls method details from papers with quoted passages, and a colleague checks a sample. Designing, testing and optimising the method stay with the biochemist. Protocols are written in the electronic notebook's template, with instrument files attached rather than copied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Methods sections were read paper by paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Screening and extraction tools with quoted sources, and electronic notebooks.
tasks.still_hard: Methods that only work after many failed tries.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing a trick from another field that solves the problem.

reach.learn: Whether notebook protocols are easier to follow.

evidence.claim: A model extracted 160 data elements from 10 trials with 96.3% accuracy; most errors were missed items.
A lab notebook drafts entries, turns PDFs into structured data and checks entries.
Generated citations were often invented: 55% for one model and 18% for another.

assumptions: Boundary: developing a method up to a written protocol; using it in studies is outside.
Design and bench work keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of method work spent on literature.

already_counted.description: Biochemist and a colleague check a sample of extracted items.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: methods built mostly at the bench; high: methods drawing on a wide literature.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read the call, develop the research idea, write grant proposals to obtain funding for research, prepare budget and annexes, have the proposal approved by the grants office and submit it.

steps.what: Biochemist reads the funding call and its requirements
Biochemist develops the research idea and aims
Biochemist writes the grant proposal text

loop.input: The funder's template and the lab's earlier approved text on data management, ethics and facilities.
loop.output: Draft standard sections in the funder's template.
loop.check: The biochemist rewrites and checks every sentence; every citation must resolve to a DOI; the scientific sections are written by the biochemist.
loop.why_not_simpler: Standard sections must be adapted to each call's wording.

steps.what: Biochemist prepares the budget, CVs and annexes
Grants officer reviews and approves the final proposal
Biochemist submits the approved proposal in the funder's portal

approvals.approved_version: the proposal as approved by the grants officer in s5; any change goes back for approval

tasks.design: The idea and the scientific case stay with the biochemist. Standard sections such as data management, ethics and facilities are drafted from the lab's earlier approved text in the funder's template, and the biochemist rewrites them. The budget template computes costs from the institute's rates, and CVs and publication lists come from the research information system. The grants officer approves before submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standard sections and annexes were rebuilt for every call.
tasks.enabler_now: Funder templates, budget calculators and research information systems.
tasks.still_hard: Writing a case that convinces a panel.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing the question a funder will pay for.

evidence.claim: A national funder bars generative AI for its assessors and hidden prompts in applications.
EU guidelines advise against generative AI in peer review and evaluations.

assumptions: Boundary: preparing and submitting one proposal; review by the funder is outside.
Input contract for s4: personnel rates from the finance department and publications registered in the research information system by the library.
Idea and submission keep their full time; the grants officer's time is outside the biochemist's savings.
unknowns: Share of proposal text that is standard sections.
research_questions: Does time per proposal fall without hurting success rates?

incremental.description: Biochemist keeps the library of approved standard text current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: short calls with few annexes; high: large consortium proposals with many standard parts.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design experiments, book instrument time, prepare samples, perform experiments with equipment such as lasers, accelerators or mass spectrometers and record run settings and data.

steps.what: Biochemist designs the experiment
Biochemist books instrument time
Biochemist prepares the samples
Biochemist performs experiments with equipment such as lasers or mass spectrometers
Biochemist records run settings and links raw data in the lab notebook

tasks.design: Instrument time is booked in the facility's booking system instead of by mail. The instrument software exports run settings with the raw files, and the electronic notebook links them to the experiment, so the biochemist adds only observations. Designing, preparing and running experiments stay fully with the biochemist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Run settings were copied from the instrument screen into notebooks.
tasks.enabler_now: Instrument exports linked to electronic notebooks and booking systems.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing a strange signal that means a new finding.

evidence.claim: Lab notebooks and inventory systems handle sample tracking and workflows.
Notebook audit trails log who did what and may count as able to observe performance.

assumptions: Boundary: one experiment from design to recorded data; analysis is outside.
Input contract for s5: settings exported by the instrument software with the raw files, about 70% of instruments; others are typed; s5 is priced at that share.
Design, preparation and running keep their full time.

incremental.description: Biochemist maps new instrument export fields to the notebook.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: older instruments without export; high: modern instruments linked to the notebook.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare samples, collect structural data, process the data, build and refine a model, and validate it to determine the three-dimensional structure of biological macromolecules.

steps.what: Biochemist prepares and crystallises samples or prepares grids
Biochemist collects structural data at the facility
Biochemist processes the data through the processing steps
Biochemist builds and refines the three-dimensional model
Biochemist validates and interprets the structure

tasks.design: Processing runs as a versioned pipeline with fixed settings per data type, started by the facility's data transfer, and the biochemist checks its quality report instead of running each program by hand. Model building starts from a predicted structure from public databases where one exists. Sample preparation, data collection and validation stay with the biochemist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each dataset was processed step by step by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned processing pipelines and public predicted structures.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether density truly supports a feature.

evidence.claim: Community pipelines have tagged releases, containers and tests.
Frontier models reached 17% accuracy on open-answer bioinformatics analyses; analysis stays scripted and checked.

assumptions: Boundary: from sample to validated structure; deposition and publication are outside.
Input contract for s3: data transferred by the facility in its standard format, about 80% of datasets; unusual data are processed by hand; s3 is priced at that share.
Preparation, collection and validation keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of targets with useful predicted structures.
research_questions: Does time from data to model fall?

incremental.description: Biochemist updates pipeline settings with the facility.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: hard targets with poor data; high: routine structures with predicted models.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
